purpose: Deterministically extract the exact owner-approved Patch 01 Cloud candidate from its white matte, preserve its connected crochet silhouette and interior stitch reading without transparent pinholes, and uniformly center it without painting, reconstruction, or distortion.

allowed: deterministic filling of fully enclosed white-matte regions to avoid transparent stitch pinholes

matte.post_resample_component_selection: retain the largest 8-connected nonzero-alpha component after each resize to suppress isolated bicubic ringing pixels
matte.external_background: discard, including disconnected and border-connected pixels
matte.contact_shadow: discard; the approved source has no contact plane and only fully enclosed white-matte regions are filled to prevent background-color pinholes
matte.edge_color: uncomposite soft-edge RGB from the fixed white matte using the computed alpha; hard foreground retains exact source RGB

source_landmarks.method: reviewed midpoint of the threshold-20 connected Cloud bounds; it is a presentation-placement anchor, not terrain authority

resampling.alpha: premultiplied during filtering, straight RGBA in PNG
resampling.png: 8-bit non-interlaced RGBA, filter type 0, deterministic zlib level 9
